Report

Models

Decision trees

aggregation_models <- readRDS(here::here("models", "aggregation_models.rds"))

Single tree

tree.loan <- aggregation_models$tree.loan

visualize_tree(model = tree.loan, aggregation = FALSE)
## 
## Classification tree:
## tree(formula = loan_status ~ ., data = train)
## Variables actually used in tree construction:
## [1] "previous_loan_defaults_on_file" "loan_percent_income"           
## [3] "loan_int_rate"                  "person_income"                 
## Number of terminal nodes:  5 
## Residual mean deviance:  0.4773 = 17180 / 36000 
## Misclassification error rate: 0.09533 = 3432 / 36000

performance_tree(model = tree.loan, test = test)
##          actual
## Predicted    0    1
##         0 6642  517
##         1  358 1483
## Misclassification rate:  0.09722222 
## Sensitivity:  0.8055405 
## Specificity :  0.9277832

## AUC:  0.9337871

rf_tuning <- readRDS(here::here("models", "rf_tuning.rds"))

plot(rf_tuning$mtry.oob$mtry, rf_tuning$mtry.oob$oob.error, type = "b", xlab = "mtry", ylab = "oob error")
points(rf_tuning$mtry.oob$mtry[rf_tuning$best.mtry.idx], rf_tuning$mtry.oob$oob.error[rf_tuning$best.mtry.idx], col = "red", pch = 20)
legend("topright",
       legend = "Minimum oob error",
       col = "red",
       pch = 20,
       bty = "n")
